outcome: Perinatal outcomes (perinatal death, preterm birth, Neonatal Intensive Care Unit admission)
cohort: Women aged 17-41 years admitted to a level 3 ICU in the Netherlands between January 1, 2000 and January 1, 2016
finding: While obstetric patients represented a small percentage of ICU admissions, they had lower mortality rates than non-obstetric patients despite a more severe initial presentation.
mod_finding: While this study mentions cesarean sections within the context of obstetric ICU admissions, it does not directly compare different modes of delivery or their outcomes.
